<script>
    var hero = document.querySelector(".hero");
    if (hero) {
        if (hero.getAttribute('data-background') !== null) {
            hero.style.backgroundImage = "url(" + hero.getAttribute('data-background') + ")";
        }
        var hero_height = 'auto';
        if (hero.getAttribute('data-height') !== null) {
            hero_height = hero.getAttribute('data-height');
        }
        hero.style.height = hero_height;
    }
</script>

<script>
    function loadExtraScript(url, action) {
        if (url) {
            var script = document.createElement('script');
            script.setAttribute("type", "text/javascript");
            script.setAttribute("src", url);
            script.setAttribute("async", "");
            script.setAttribute("onload", action);
            document.getElementsByTagName("body")[0].appendChild(script);
        }
    }
    function init() {

        Actonjs.app.default.init();

        Actonjs.app.home.init();loadExtraScript("/includes/plugins/wow/wow.js","new WOW().init();");
            }
</script>
<script async="" onload="init();" src="/js/default-08ecc484a8.js" type="text/javascript"></script>
